tenants.passwordUnchangedHint: leave blank to keep the stored password

dashboard.collectNowError: Collection failed to run. Check the server logs for details.

licenses.connectionHint: Where this tenant's ProfileUnity License Server lives, and the credential used to manage it — the username/password embedded in that server's own MongoDB connection string. This is separate from the tenant's own console login above.
licenses.passwordUnchangedHint: leave blank to keep the stored password
licenses.checkupError: Could not reach the License Server. Check the settings above.
licenses.saveError: Could Not Save License Server Connection
licenses.pushHint: Paste the signed license code Liquidware issued for this tenant. It's decoded locally for your review before anything is sent.
licenses.licenseCodePlaceholder: Paste the base64 license code here…
licenses.previewError: Could not decode that license — check it's the full base64 code.
licenses.pushWarning: This replaces the license currently installed on this server. The License Server keeps exactly one active license — pushing purges the existing one and its seat assignments. There's no undo.
licenses.pushError: Could not push the license. Check the connection above and try again.
licenses.pushConfirmMessage: This replaces the current license on {{hostname}} and purges its seat assignments. This cannot be undone.
licenses.historyHint: Every push attempt for this tenant — what was pushed, by whom, and the outcome. The License Server itself keeps no history of its own.

settings.saveHint: Save applies to everything below — Company Branding, Email, Monthly Portfolio Report, Collection, and Operator Sessions. The TLS Certificate and Company Logo sections further down have their own buttons and take effect immediately, without needing Save.
settings.tlsAppliesImmediatelyHint: Uploading here takes effect immediately — no need to click Save above.
settings.logoAppliesImmediatelyHint: Uploading or removing a logo here takes effect immediately — no need to click Save above.
settings.companyNameHint: Shown alongside Liquidware's own branding on every PDF report.
settings.logoGuidance: PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB. It's shown on a white background, so your logo's own colors render true-to-life. A wide, landscape shape (roughly 4:1, like a wordmark) fits better than a square or tall logo.
settings.logoUploadError: Could not upload that logo — make sure it's a PNG or JPEG image under 2 MB.
settings.smtpPasswordUnchangedHint: leave blank to keep the stored password
settings.smtpFromRequiredHint: Required once an SMTP host is set.
settings.smtpHostRequiredHint: An SMTP host is required when a From address or report recipients are set.
settings.testEmailError: Could not send the test email. Check the settings above.
settings.reportRecipientsRequiredHint: At least one recipient is required once an SMTP host is set.
settings.sendReportNowConfirmMessage: This immediately emails last month's portfolio report to every recipient configured above.
settings.sendReportNowError: Could not send the report. Check the settings above and the server logs for details.
settings.tlsCertUploadError: Could not activate that certificate — check that the certificate and key are a matching PEM pair.
